fact_status.sql: SELECT calendar_year, is_adjusted_source, COUNT(*) records, SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN is_quantity_observation_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) observed_quantity_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales<0 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) negative_net_sales FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 17 GROUP BY calendar_year,is_adjusted_source ORDER BY calendar_year,is_adjusted_source

catalog_status.sql: SELECT COALESCE(category_status,'(null)') category_status,COALESCE(identity_status,'(null)') identity_status,COUNT(*) records,SUM(CASE WHEN is_net_sales_eligible THEN net_sales END) revenue FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 17 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY records DESC

model_counts.sql: SELECT 'run' kind,COUNT(*) rows FROM workspace.medshield_gold.fact_forecast_run_candidate UNION ALL SELECT 'point',COUNT(*) FROM workspace.medshield_gold.fact_forecast_point_candidate UNION ALL SELECT 'evaluation',COUNT(*) FROM workspace.medshield_gold.fact_model_evaluation_candidate UNION ALL SELECT 'review',COUNT(*) FROM workspace.medshield_gold.fact_model_review UNION ALL SELECT 'release',COUNT(*) FROM workspace.medshield_gold.model_release_manifest UNION ALL SELECT 'pointer',COUNT(*) FROM workspace.medshield_gold.model_release_pointer

nasa_weather.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) rows, MIN(period_start) first_month, MAX(period_start) last_month FROM workspace.medshield_gold.vw_weather_nasa_power_monthly_candidate
